item.description:
TEO SOON Homemade Dry Chili Pan Mee
Enjoy authentic handmade dry noodles crafted from fresh ingredients, directly stocked from the factory. Each pack is individually sealed for hygiene and convenience.

Product Features:
🍝Halal Certified Product
🍝Fresh ingredients, direct from factory
🍝Individually packed – clean and convenient

Ingredients (Original Flavour):
🍜Pan Mee (Flour, Salt)
🍜Chili Flakes
🍜Seasoning Sauce (Dark Soy Sauce, Light Soy Sauce/Fish Extract)
🍜Garlic Oil
Ingredients (Dry Chili Flavour):
🍜Pan Mee (Flour, Salt)
🍜Chili Flakes
🍜Seasoning Sauce (Dark Soy Sauce, Light Soy Sauce/Fish Extract)
🍜Sambal (Cooking Oil, Garlic, Dried Chili, Fish Sauce, Sugar, Oyster Sauce, Salt, Onion, Chili Padi, Fine Shrimp, Ajinomoto)
✨Dry Chili Flavour includes sambal and chili flakes – adjust amount for milder spiciness.

Product Information:
Origin: Made in Malaysia
Weight: ~110g – 120g per pack
Shelf Life: 9 months from production date
👍Cooking Step👍: 1. Place noodles into boiling water, cook for 8 minutes. 2. Drain the noodles. 3. Add seasoning and sauce. 4. Mix well and serve.

Caution:
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
Consume before the expiry date for the best taste and quality.
Avoid excessive chili powder if you have low spice tolerance.
